notes.title: Cloud Save Support
notes.content:
A feature we noticed requested by the community has been added. 

Cloud saves will make it easier for you to move between machines without having to manually take that save file with you. 

Cloud saves are generally enabled by default. 

Be aware that the cloud saves may only perform the first back up after you run the game for the first time post this update.  This will back up your .hp* files only.
